product.name: Telmai Data Observability Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for continuously monitoring, validating, and analyzing structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data across lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streams, and upstream sources.

product.name: Data Quality
product.description: Continuous monitoring and validation of data quality across data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streams, and other pipeline sources.

product.name: Anomaly Detection
product.description: Machine-learning-based detection of unusual changes in column values, data distributions, volumes, schemas, and aggregated business metrics.

product.name: Data Layer Consistency
product.description: Cross-system monitoring that compares data across sources, targets, and processing layers to identify inconsistencies and synchronization issues.

product.name: Complete Pipeline Observability
product.description: End-to-end monitoring of data pipelines, from upstream sources and raw data through transformations, warehouses, lakehouses, and analytics-ready outputs.

product.name: Incident Management
product.description: A capability for detecting, diagnosing, prioritizing, and tracking data incidents before they affect downstream users, applications, or AI workflows.
